scale: delivery-plan.md: fixed 100-point planning rubric, not measured coverage
note: Coarse items are not closed by passing a limited corpus. No completion percentage is published.

items.note: String and bytes search has a large differential. Iterator copy contracts are still incomplete.
Captures are tested. Independent iterator copies are not fully audited.
Replace and split are tested. Mid-iteration state copies are not fully audited.
RegexSet matching and SetMatches iteration exist. The full builder matrix is not closed.
Only the locked 1-point subset may be accepted later. The other 2 points stay open.
HIR nodes, class operations, and the tested properties exist. memory_usage is not claimed.
AST parse no longer runs the matcher first. Class items carry spans and literal kinds for the differential corpus. The corpus is not every AST field.
translate honors utf8. (?-u:\xFF), (?-u:.), (?-u:\D), and unknown properties fail at translation. The full translator is not closed.
AST and HIR display were compared on the corpus. walk and walkUntil exist. The upstream visitor trait is not fully audited.

Default prefix and suffix extraction matches regex-syntax on the corpus, including class, repeat, and total limits. Public UTF-8 sequences match Utf8Sequences debug text. memory_usage is not part of this item. Corpus evidence only; public configuration, cache and remaining auxiliary contracts have not been fully audited.
String ranges, anchoring, and pattern ids exist. There is no independent Input type or byte PikeVM.
Forward NFA construction is inside Regex. It is not yet a public object with a checked state graph.

Reverse search walks bytes backward and reports the match start. Offsets match dense DFA try_search_rev, including anchors and multi-byte scalars. Captures are omitted. Unicode word boundaries are outside this oracle because that DFA refuses them. Corpus evidence only; public configuration, cache and remaining auxiliary contracts have not been fully audited.
Forward search with a range and an anchor exists.
Multiple patterns are searched one Regex at a time, then ordered. That is not one multi-pattern PikeVM.
PikeCache stores the previous capture slots. It is not the search thread queue.
whichOverlapping returns the same pattern-id set as PikeVM which_overlapping_matches on the corpus. Each pattern is still searched separately, so this point stays open.
searchEarliest matches regex-automata earliest spans on the corpus. quit is still absent, so this point stays open.
Only the locked 2-point subset may be accepted later.

DenseDfa and SparseDfa match dfa::regex::Regex spans for one pattern on the corpus, including anchors and ASCII word boundaries. Unicode word boundaries fail during construction. The match start is the reverse NFA on the forward end. Quit bytes, multiple patterns, overlapping search, CRLF anchors, and the upstream byte size limit are absent, so these 6 points stay open.
Hybrid DFA is absent. dfaSizeLimit remains a string step-cache budget.
One-pass search is absent.

Visited-set backtracking matches BoundedBacktracker spans and captures on the corpus. A haystack that does not fit in the visited table returns haystack-too-long instead of a miss. maxHaystackLen uses this NFA's state count, so the numeric limit is not the upstream number. Corpus evidence only; public configuration, cache and remaining auxiliary contracts have not been fully audited.
Meta engine and the optimization passes around it are absent. Regex.find is still the existing matcher.
Serialization is absent.
Only the locked 1-point regex-cli find match subset may be accepted later.

selected_subsets.A5: Candidate: actual size/nest-limit rejection contracts. Describing a different dfaSizeLimit meaning does not earn equivalence credit.
selected_subsets.C4: The 2 points are capture metadata (names, length, static length) and SetMatches bidirectional iteration as shared result types. Input and PikeVM captures already listed under C1/C3 are not scored again here.
selected_subsets.E: The 1 point is upstream regex-cli find match for the NFA/PikeVM command: span text and exit status. This repository's demo CLI does not count, and generate/serialize commands stay outside this point.
